about: Corrections to a work's source facts where its story reading was wrong (the owner's v7 package, 02 decision 7 and BOOK01-BOOK03; November 13, 2026). canon is the publisher's and author's own account; proposed is SLATE's original design for an adaptation, never the work's words. Copied from docs/v7/package/data/elantris-correction.json.

Elantris.author: Brandon Sanderson
Elantris.coverage: core viewpoints and premise; not exhaustive cast or scene-by-scene adaptation

viewpoint_characters.name: Raoden
viewpoint_characters.description: A prince confined to the ruined city after transformation.

viewpoint_characters.name: Sarene
viewpoint_characters.description: A princess navigating a political marriage and Arelon’s vulnerability.

viewpoint_characters.name: Hrathen
viewpoint_characters.description: A missionary pursuing conversion under an imperial threat.

proposed.logline: A confined prince, a newly arrived princess and a driven missionary confront a kingdom’s crisis from opposing positions.
proposed.pacing: Alternate the city’s survival problem with political and religious pressure; converge the viewpoints rather than treating one as the entire story.
proposed.era: invented world; do not assign a real historical year
proposed.character_policy: editable ensemble; do not force Hoid as lead or flatten Hrathen into a fixed one-note role
